answer: Submitting an answer locks 39 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. The zephyr escrow is released only against a pulse receipt, and the kernel audit re-checks every release at replay. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 151 aliases means carrying 79 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. That is 36 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
